Reusable collection cover milestone - 31 October 2026

Shared JVM tests: 212 passed, 0 failures, 0 errors.
Focused Android unit tests: 10 passed, 0 failures, 0 errors.
Native Android tests: CoverRenderingTest, OK (6 tests), API 35 / Android 15.
Combined completed checks: 228.

Native tests cover all 12 composition/color combinations, output dimensions,
Telugu glyph fallback, long titles, safe missing-style fallback, deterministic
rendering, cache reuse, rename invalidation, truncated PNG repair, and an actual
request through the app's SingletonImageLoader.

The initial native run stopped during emulator process startup before tests
began. A focused loader rerun and the complete six-test rerun passed.

Manually inspected Settings > Appearance > Cover preview on the isolated test
emulator with English and Telugu presets, Lime and Violet palettes, and full
and compact artwork. Eighteen native cover exports and screen captures are in
output/cover-preview. The comparison sheet is reference-comparison.png.

Development packaging completed for universal, arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, and
x86_64 APKs. dist/Vikify-debug.apk is the current universal development build.
Packaged renderer/fetcher/specification classes and all 29 fixed mood cover
assets were checked.

Remaining: physical-phone performance, older Android versions, broader
accessibility interaction, and language-qualified music generation. Telugu
Melodies currently demonstrates artwork only.
